rows.grounds: token 0; 'suvāsinī' denotes a married/well-adorned woman in ritual context (Dāśarathīyatantra, v.7643)
token 1; first part of hyphen-split compound 'paṃcadaśa' (fifteen), forming 'paṃcadaśaṣṭānnais' with tokens 2 (Dāśarathīyatantra, v.7643)
token 2; continuation of compound 'paṃcadaśa-aṣṭa-annaiḥ' (with fifteen and eight foods) (Dāśarathīyatantra, v.7643)
token 3; optative sense of pleasing/satisfying in ritual instruction (Dāśarathīyatantra, v.7643)
token 4; 'vratī' denotes one observing a vow/rite (Dāśarathīyatantra, v.7643)
